name: Knott's Mrs. Knott's Golden Chicken Pot Pie with Flaky Pastry Crust
brandOrRestaurant: Mrs. Knott's Chicken Dinner Restaurant (Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Tender shredded chicken breast and soft diced carrots simmered in rich chicken gravy under a golden, flaky pastry crust. Comforting and easy to break down in remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Chicken Pot Pie; eat the tender chicken, soft carrots, and flaky top crust (leave whole green peas if pea skins cause gas).
watchOuts: Whole green peas can produce mild gas in sensitive intestines
